triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.file.cli-term-go
triples.object:
Package cli provides terminal I/O helpers and interactive wizards for
configuring semsource from the command line.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-add-go-Add
triples.object:
Add either runs the interactive wizard to add a source (no extra args),
or parses non-interactive flags for the given typeKey.

args are the arguments after "semsource add", e.g. ["ast", "--path", "./src"].

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-add-go-Add
triples.object: func Add(term *Term, configPath string, args []string) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-add-go-addNonInteractive
triples.object: addNonInteractive dispatches to a type-specific flag parser.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-DetectProject
triples.object: DetectProject scans the given directory and returns what it finds.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-deriveNamespace
triples.object:
deriveNamespace extracts an org/owner name from the git remote URL,
falling back to the directory name.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-detectGitRemote
triples.object: detectGitRemote runs git to get the origin remote URL.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-orgFromRemote
triples.object:
orgFromRemote extracts the org/owner segment from common git remote formats:
  - https://github.com/acme/repo.git  -> acme
  - git@github.com:acme/repo.git      -> acme

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-resolvableGitURL
triples.object:
resolvableGitURL returns a git source URL that yields a non-empty source
identity: the origin remote when available, else the repository's absolute
path. Never "." — it slugs to an empty system segment, so every commit
entity is rejected at the publish gate while status looks healthy (audit
2026-07-19: the default install ingested zero git history).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-detect-go-sanitizeName
triples.object: sanitizeName lowercases and replaces non-alphanumeric chars with hyphens.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-registry-go-RegisterSourceWizard
triples.object:
RegisterSourceWizard adds a wizard to the global registry.
Call this from init() functions in wizard_*.go files.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-registry-go-Wizards
triples.object: Wizards returns all registered source wizards.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-remove-go-Remove
triples.object:
Remove lets the user remove a source from the config.
If index is >= 0, it removes that source directly (non-interactive).
Otherwise it shows a numbered list and prompts for selection.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-remove-go-Remove
triples.object: func Remove(term *Term, configPath string, index int) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-sources-go-Sources
triples.object: Sources loads the config at configPath and prints a formatted table of sources.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-sources-go-truncate
triples.object: func truncate(s string, maxLen int) string

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-term-go-NewTerm
triples.object: NewTerm creates a Term reading from r and writing to w.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-validate-go-Validate
triples.object: Validate loads the config at configPath and prints a validation result.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-Init
triples.object:
Init runs the interactive setup wizard and writes semsource.json.
It auto-detects the project context to provide smart defaults.
An optional ProjectInfo can be passed to override auto-detection (for testing).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-Init
triples.object: func Init(term *Term, configPath string, overrides ...*ProjectInfo) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-InitQuick
triples.object:
InitQuick runs a zero-prompt setup using auto-detected defaults.
Falls back to interactive Init if detection finds nothing useful.
An optional ProjectInfo can be passed to override auto-detection (for testing).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-InitQuick
triples.object: func InitQuick(term *Term, configPath string, overrides ...*ProjectInfo) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-buildDetectedSources
triples.object: buildDetectedSources creates SourceEntry values from auto-detected project info.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-runSourceMenu
triples.object: runSourceMenu shows the numbered toggle menu, pre-selecting based on detection.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-shouldPreselect
triples.object: shouldPreselect returns true if a source type is relevant to the detected project.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard-go-writeAndSummarize
triples.object: func writeAndSummarize(term *Term, configPath string, cfg *config.Config) error

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard_ast-go-detectLanguage
triples.object: detectLanguage checks for common manifest files in the current directory.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard_image-go-boolPtr
triples.object: boolPtr returns a pointer to the given bool value.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard_image-go-detectImagePaths
triples.object: detectImagePaths checks for common image directories in the working directory.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.function.cli-wizard_video-go-ffmpegAvailable
triples.object: ffmpegAvailable reports whether ffmpeg is present in PATH.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.interface.cli-registry-go-SourceWizard
triples.object: SourceWizard defines interactive prompts for one source type.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Confirm
triples.object:
Confirm prints a Y/n or y/N prompt and returns true for yes.
defaultYes controls which answer is the default (Enter with no input).

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Confirm
triples.object: func (t *Term) Confirm(label string, defaultYes bool) bool

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Header
triples.object: Header prints a bold section header.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Info
triples.object: Info prints a plain informational line.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-MultiLine
triples.object:
MultiLine collects lines until the user submits an empty line.
The label is shown once before input begins.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Println
triples.object: Println prints a line with a trailing newline.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Prompt
triples.object:
Prompt prints label and reads a line. If the user enters nothing,
defaultVal is returned. The default is shown in brackets when non-empty.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Prompt
triples.object: func (t *Term) Prompt(label string, defaultVal string) string

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Select
triples.object:
Select prints a numbered list and returns the 0-based index of the choice.
Re-prompts on invalid input. Returns 0 if options is empty.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-Success
triples.object: Success prints a green checkmark with a message.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.method.cli-term-go-Term-readLine
triples.object:
readLine reads the next line of input, trimming whitespace.
Returns the line and true, or "" and false on EOF/error.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.struct.cli-detect-go-ProjectInfo
triples.object: ProjectInfo holds auto-detected facts about the current working directory.

triples.subject: semselect.semsource.golang.semsource-cli.struct.cli-term-go-Term
triples.object: Term wraps terminal I/O so prompts are testable via piped input.
